title: Prices move from cents to dollars under a new reader
story: A stores catalog prices in dollars (the product API gives dollars) and converts with cents() everywhere it found a price: pricing and the shop page. B adds a price list for the till, written when price meant cents, so it formats p.price as cents. Together, the till says eggs cost $0.04. Both are numbers, so the type-checker can't tell.

a.why: the product API should give prices in dollars

fact.sentence: The product API gives prices in dollars

b.why: print a price list for the till

fact.sentence: The till prints a price list with every product's price

resolution: The till formats cents(p), A's conversion, instead of p.price.
